title: PhotosBackup
tagline: A google photo alternative (cheap and completely decentralised)
description: No need to upload your photos to google or send any private data to institutions, we use IPFS to store and back all your phone photos periodically. You can connect your wallet connect wallet and start uploading your photos just for 0.5 USDC per month. You can even upload videos or backup your existing files to ipfs via phone.
how_its_made:
The project uses react native for mobile development, IPFS for photo storage, wallet connect for authentication.

No need to upload your photos to google or send any private data to institutions, we use IPFS to store and back all your phone photos periodically. You can connect your wallet connect wallet and start uploading your photos just for 0.5 USDC per month.
